12 /-!
13 # The unit interval, as a topological space
14 
15 Use `open unitInterval` to turn on the notation `I := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ)`.
16 
17 We provide basic instances, as well as a custom tactic for discharging
18 `0 ≤ ↑x`, `0 ≤ 1 - ↑x`, `↑x ≤ 1`, and `1 - ↑x ≤ 1` when `x : I`.
19 
20 -/
21 
22 @[expose] public section
23 
24 noncomputable section
25 
26 open Topology Filter Set Int Set.Icc
27

31 /-- The unit interval `[0,1]` in ℝ. -/
32 abbrev unitInterval : Set ℝ :=
33   Set.Icc 0 1

40 theorem zero_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ I :=
41   ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
42 
43 theorem one_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ I :=
44   ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
45 
46 theorem mul_mem {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I) (hy : y ∈ I) : x * y ∈ I :=
47   ⟨mul_nonneg hx.1 hy.1, mul_le_one₀ hx.2 hy.1 hy.2⟩
48 
49 theorem div_mem {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hxy : x ≤ y) : x / y ∈ I :=
50   ⟨div_nonneg hx hy, div_le_one_of_le₀ hxy hy⟩
51 
52 theorem fract_mem (x : ℝ) : fract x ∈ I :=
53   ⟨fract_nonneg _, (fract_lt_one _).le⟩

75 def symm : I → I := fun t => ⟨1 - t, Icc.mem_iff_one_sub_mem.mp t.prop⟩

105 theorem symm_projIcc (x : ℝ) :
106     symm (projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one x) = projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one (1 - x) := by

108   rcases le_total x 0 with h₀ | h₀

113     · simp [projIcc_of_le_left, projIcc_of_right_le, h₁]

216   carrier := unitInterval
217   one_mem' := unitInterval.one_mem
218   mul_mem' := unitInterval.mul_mem

225     (h : ∀ c ∈ t, f c ∈ unitInterval) :
226     ∏ c ∈ t, f c ∈ unitInterval := _root_.prod_mem (S := unitInterval.submonoid) h

260 -- TODO: Set.projIci, Set.projIic
261 /-- `Set.projIcc` is a contraction. -/
262 lemma _root_.Set.abs_projIcc_sub_projIcc : (|projIcc a b h c - projIcc a b h d| : α) ≤ |c - d| := by
263   wlog hdc : d ≤ c generalizing c d
264   · rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_sub_comm c]; exact this (le_of_not_ge hdc)
265   rw [abs_eq_self.2 (sub_nonneg.2 hdc),
266     abs_eq_self.2 (sub_nonneg.2 <| mod_cast monotone_projIcc h hdc)]
267   rw [← sub_nonneg] at hdc
268   refine (max_sub_max_le_max _ _ _ _).trans (max_le (by rwa [sub_self]) ?_)
269   refine ((le_abs_self _).trans <| abs_min_sub_min_le_max _ _ _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
270   · rwa [sub_self, abs_zero]
271   · exact (abs_eq_self.mpr hdc).le
272 
273 /-- When `h : a ≤ b` and `δ > 0`, `addNSMul h δ` is a sequence of points in the closed interval
274 `[a,b]`, which is initially equally spaced but eventually stays at the right endpoint `b`. -/
275 def addNSMul (δ : α) (n : ℕ) : Icc a b := projIcc a b h (a + n • δ)
276 
277 omit [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] in
278 lemma addNSMul_zero : addNSMul h δ 0 = a := by
279   rw [addNSMul, zero_smul, add_zero, projIcc_left]
280 
281 lemma addNSMul_eq_right [Archimedean α] (hδ : 0 < δ) :
282     ∃ m, ∀ n ≥ m, addNSMul h δ n = b := by
283   obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Archimedean.arch (b - a) hδ
284   refine ⟨m, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
285   rw [addNSMul, coe_projIcc, add_comm, min_eq_left_iff.mpr, max_eq_right h]
286   exact sub_le_iff_le_add.mp (hm.trans <| nsmul_le_nsmul_left hδ.le hn)
287 
288 lemma monotone_addNSMul (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) : Monotone (addNSMul h δ) :=
289   fun _ _ hnm ↦ monotone_projIcc h <| (add_le_add_iff_left _).mpr (nsmul_le_nsmul_left hδ hnm)
290 
291 lemma abs_sub_addNSMul_le (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) {t : Icc a b} (n : ℕ)
292     (ht : t ∈ Icc (addNSMul h δ n) (addNSMul h δ (n + 1))) :
293     (|t - addNSMul h δ n| : α) ≤ δ :=
294   calc
295     (|t - addNSMul h δ n| : α) = t - addNSMul h δ n := abs_eq_self.2 <| sub_nonneg.2 ht.1
296     _ ≤ projIcc a b h (a + (n + 1) • δ) - addNSMul h δ n := by apply sub_le_sub_right; exact ht.2
297     _ ≤ (|projIcc a b h (a + (n + 1) • δ) - addNSMul h δ n| : α) := le_abs_self _
298     _ ≤ |a + (n + 1) • δ - (a + n • δ)| := abs_projIcc_sub_projIcc h
299     _ ≤ δ := by
300           rw [add_sub_add_comm, sub_self, zero_add, succ_nsmul', add_sub_cancel_right]
301           exact (abs_eq_self.mpr hδ).le
302 
303 /--
304 Form a convex linear combination of two points in a closed interval.
305 
306 This should be removed once a general theory of convex spaces is available in Mathlib.
307 -/
308 def convexCombo {a b : ℝ} (x y : Icc a b) (t : unitInterval) : Icc a b :=
309   ⟨(1 - t) * x + t * y, by
310     constructor
311     · nlinarith [x.2.1, y.2.1, t.2.1, t.2.2]
312     · nlinarith [x.2.2, y.2.2, t.2.1, t.2.2]⟩
313 
314 @[simp, grind =]
315 theorem coe_convexCombo {a b : ℝ} (x y : Icc a b) (t : unitInterval) :
316   (convexCombo x y t : ℝ) = (1 - t) * x + t * y := rfl
317 
318 @[simp, grind =]
319 theorem convexCombo_zero {a b : ℝ} (x y : Icc a b) : convexCombo x y 0 = x := by
320   simp [convexCombo]
321 
322 @[simp, grind =]
323 theorem convexCombo_one {a b : ℝ} (x y : Icc a b) : convexCombo x y 1 = y := by
324   simp [convexCombo]
325 
326 @[simp, grind =]
327 theorem convexCombo_zero_one (t : unitInterval) : convexCombo 0 1 t = t := by
328   simp [convexCombo]
329 
330 @[simp, grind =]
331 theorem convexCombo_eq {a b : ℝ} (x : Icc a b) (t : unitInterval) : convexCombo x x t = x := by
332   simp [convexCombo, sub_mul]
333 
334 @[simp, grind =]
335 theorem convexCombo_symm {a b : ℝ} (x y : Icc a b) (t : unitInterval) :
336     convexCombo x y (unitInterval.symm t) = convexCombo y x t := by
337   simp [convexCombo]
338   abel
339 
340 @[grind .]
341 theorem le_convexCombo {a b : ℝ} {x y : Icc a b} (h : x ≤ y) (t : unitInterval) :
342     x ≤ convexCombo x y t := by
343   rw [← Subtype.coe_le_coe] at h ⊢
344   simp
345   nlinarith [t.2.1, t.2.2]
346 
347 @[grind .]
348 theorem convexCombo_le {a b : ℝ} {x y : Icc a b} (h : x ≤ y) (t : unitInterval) :
349     convexCombo x y t ≤ y := by
350   rw [← Subtype.coe_le_coe] at h ⊢
351   simp
352   nlinarith [t.2.1, t.2.2]
353 
354 @[continuity, fun_prop]
355 theorem continuous_convexCombo {a b : ℝ} (x y : Icc a b) : Continuous (convexCombo x y) := by
356   unfold Icc.convexCombo
357   fun_prop
358 
359 @[continuity, fun_prop]
360 theorem continuous_convexCombo_prod {a b : ℝ} :
361     Continuous fun x : Icc a b × Icc a b × unitInterval ↦ Icc.convexCombo x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2 := by
362   unfold Icc.convexCombo
363   fun_prop

365 /--
366 Helper definition for `convexCombo_assoc`, giving one of the coefficients appearing
367 when we reassociate a convex combination.
368 -/
369 abbrev convexCombo_assoc_coeff₁ (s t : unitInterval) : unitInterval :=
370   ⟨s * (1 - t) / (1 - s * t),
371     by
372       apply div_nonneg
373       · nlinarith [s.2.1, t.2.2]
374       · nlinarith [s.2.2, t.2.2, t.2.1],
375     by
376       apply div_le_one_of_le₀
377       · nlinarith [s.2.2]
378       · nlinarith [s.2.2, t.2.2, t.2.1]⟩
379 
380 /--
381 Helper definition for `convexCombo_assoc`, giving one of the coefficients appearing
382 when we reassociate a convex combination.
383 -/
384 abbrev convexCombo_assoc_coeff₂ (s t : unitInterval) : unitInterval := s * t
385 
386 theorem convexCombo_assoc {a b : ℝ} (x y z : Icc a b) (s t : unitInterval) :
387     convexCombo x (convexCombo y z t) s =
388       convexCombo (convexCombo x y (convexCombo_assoc_coeff₁ s t)) z
389         (convexCombo_assoc_coeff₂ s t) := by
390   simp only [convexCombo, coe_mul, Subtype.mk.injEq]
391   by_cases hs : (s : ℝ) = 1
392   · simp only [hs]
393     by_cases ht : (t : ℝ) = 1
394     · simp [ht]
395     · have : (1 - t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by grind
396       field_simp
397       simp
398   · by_cases ht : (t : ℝ) = 1
399     · simp [ht]
400     · have : (1 - s * t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
401         intro h
402         have : 1 ≤ (t : ℝ) := by nlinarith [s.2.2, t.2.1]
403         grind
404       field_simp
405       ring_nf
406 
407 /--
408 Helper definition for `convexCombo_assoc'`, giving one of the coefficients appearing
409 when we reassociate a convex combination in the reverse direction.
410 -/
411 abbrev convexCombo_assoc_coeff₁' (s t : unitInterval) : unitInterval :=
412   unitInterval.symm (convexCombo_assoc_coeff₂ (unitInterval.symm t) (unitInterval.symm s))
413 
414 /--
415 Helper definition for `convexCombo_assoc'`, giving one of the coefficients appearing
416 when we reassociate a convex combination in the reverse direction.
417 -/
418 abbrev convexCombo_assoc_coeff₂' (s t : unitInterval) : unitInterval :=
419   unitInterval.symm (convexCombo_assoc_coeff₁ (unitInterval.symm t) (unitInterval.symm s))
420 
421 theorem convexCombo_assoc' {a b : ℝ} (x y z : Icc a b) (s t : unitInterval) :
422     convexCombo (convexCombo x y s) z t =
423       convexCombo x (convexCombo y z (convexCombo_assoc_coeff₂' s t))
424         (convexCombo_assoc_coeff₁' s t) := by
425   rw [← convexCombo_symm, ← convexCombo_symm y x, convexCombo_assoc, ← convexCombo_symm x,
426     ← convexCombo_symm z y]
427   rw [convexCombo_assoc_coeff₁', convexCombo_assoc_coeff₂', unitInterval.symm_symm]

429 set_option backward.privateInPublic true in
430 private theorem eq_convexCombo.zero_le {a b : ℝ} {x y z : Icc a b} (hxy : x ≤ y) (hyz : y ≤ z) :
431     0 ≤ ((y - x) / (z - x) : ℝ) := by
432   by_cases h : (z - x : ℝ) = 0
433   · simp_all
434   · replace hxy : (x : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) := hxy
435     replace hyz : (y : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := hyz
436     apply div_nonneg <;> grind
437 
438 set_option backward.privateInPublic true in
439 private theorem eq_convexCombo.le_one {a b : ℝ} {x y z : Icc a b} (hxy : x ≤ y) (hyz : y ≤ z) :
440     ((y - x) / (z - x) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
441   by_cases h : (z - x : ℝ) = 0
442   · simp_all
443   · replace hxy : (x : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) := hxy
444     replace hyz : (y : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := hyz
445     apply div_le_one_of_le₀ <;> grind

448 set_option backward.privateInPublic.warn false in
449 /--
450 A point between two points in a closed interval
451 can be expressed as a convex combination of them.
452 -/
453 theorem eq_convexCombo {a b : ℝ} {x y z : Icc a b} (hxy : x ≤ y) (hyz : y ≤ z) :
454     y = convexCombo x z ⟨((y - x) / (z - x)),
455           eq_convexCombo.zero_le hxy hyz, eq_convexCombo.le_one hxy hyz⟩ := by
456   ext
457   simp only [coe_convexCombo]
458   by_cases h : (z - x : ℝ) = 0
459   · simp_all only [div_zero, sub_zero, one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
460     replace hxy : (x : ℝ) ≤ (y : ℝ) := hxy
461     replace hyz : (y : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := hyz
462     linarith
463   · field_simp
464     ring_nf
465

470 /-- Any open cover `c` of a closed interval `[a, b]` in ℝ
471 can be refined to a finite partition into subintervals. -/
472 lemma exists_monotone_Icc_subset_open_cover_Icc {ι} {a b : ℝ} (h : a ≤ b) {c : ι → Set (Icc a b)}
473     (hc₁ : ∀ i, IsOpen (c i)) (hc₂ : univ ⊆ ⋃ i, c i) : ∃ t : ℕ → Icc a b, t 0 = a ∧
474       Monotone t ∧ (∃ m, ∀ n ≥ m, t n = b) ∧ ∀ n, ∃ i, Icc (t n) (t (n + 1)) ⊆ c i := by
475   obtain ⟨δ, δ_pos, ball_subset⟩ := lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric isCompact_univ hc₁ hc₂
476   have hδ := half_pos δ_pos
477   refine ⟨addNSMul h (δ/2), addNSMul_zero h,
478     monotone_addNSMul h hδ.le, addNSMul_eq_right h hδ, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
479   obtain ⟨i, hsub⟩ := ball_subset (addNSMul h (δ / 2) n) trivial
480   exact ⟨i, fun t ht ↦ hsub ((abs_sub_addNSMul_le h hδ.le n ht).trans_lt <| half_lt_self δ_pos)⟩
481 
482 /-- Any open cover of the unit interval can be refined to a finite partition into subintervals. -/
483 lemma exists_monotone_Icc_subset_open_cover_unitInterval {ι} {c : ι → Set I}
484     (hc₁ : ∀ i, IsOpen (c i)) (hc₂ : univ ⊆ ⋃ i, c i) : ∃ t : ℕ → I, t 0 = 0 ∧
485       Monotone t ∧ (∃ n, ∀ m ≥ n, t m = 1) ∧ ∀ n, ∃ i, Icc (t n) (t (n + 1)) ⊆ c i := by
486   simp_rw [← Subtype.coe_inj]
487   exact exists_monotone_Icc_subset_open_cover_Icc zero_le_one hc₁ hc₂
488 
489 lemma exists_monotone_Icc_subset_open_cover_unitInterval_prod_self {ι} {c : ι → Set (I × I)}
490     (hc₁ : ∀ i, IsOpen (c i)) (hc₂ : univ ⊆ ⋃ i, c i) :
491     ∃ t : ℕ → I, t 0 = 0 ∧ Monotone t ∧ (∃ n, ∀ m ≥ n, t m = 1) ∧
492       ∀ n m, ∃ i, Icc (t n) (t (n + 1)) ×ˢ Icc (t m) (t (m + 1)) ⊆ c i := by
493   obtain ⟨δ, δ_pos, ball_subset⟩ := lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric isCompact_univ hc₁ hc₂
494   have hδ := half_pos δ_pos
495   simp_rw [Subtype.ext_iff]
496   have h : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := zero_le_one
497   refine ⟨addNSMul h (δ/2), addNSMul_zero h,
498     monotone_addNSMul h hδ.le, addNSMul_eq_right h hδ, fun n m ↦ ?_⟩
499   obtain ⟨i, hsub⟩ := ball_subset (addNSMul h (δ / 2) n, addNSMul h (δ / 2) m) trivial
500   exact ⟨i, fun t ht ↦ hsub (Metric.mem_ball.mpr <| (max_le (abs_sub_addNSMul_le h hδ.le n ht.1) <|
501     abs_sub_addNSMul_le h hδ.le m ht.2).trans_lt <| half_lt_self δ_pos)⟩
502 
503 end partition
504 
505 @[simp]
506 theorem projIcc_eq_zero {x : ℝ} : projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one x = 0 ↔ x ≤ 0 :=
507   projIcc_eq_left zero_lt_one
508 
509 @[simp]
510 theorem projIcc_eq_one {x : ℝ} : projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one x = 1 ↔ 1 ≤ x :=
511   projIcc_eq_right zero_lt_one
512 
513 namespace Tactic.Interactive
514 
515 /-- A tactic that solves `0 ≤ ↑x`, `0 ≤ 1 - ↑x`, `↑x ≤ 1`, and `1 - ↑x ≤ 1` for `x : I`. -/
516 macro "unit_interval" : tactic =>
517   `(tactic| (first
518   | apply unitInterval.nonneg
519   | apply unitInterval.one_minus_nonneg
520   | apply unitInterval.le_one
521   | apply unitInterval.one_minus_le_one))
522 
523 example (x : unitInterval) : 0 ≤ (x : ℝ) := by unit_interval
524 
525 end Tactic.Interactive
526 
527 section
528 
529 variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜]
530   [TopologicalSpace 𝕜] [IsTopologicalRing 𝕜]
531 
532 -- We only need the ordering on `𝕜` here to avoid talking about flipping the interval over.
533 -- At the end of the day I only care about `ℝ`, so I'm hesitant to put work into generalizing.
534 /-- The image of `[0,1]` under the homeomorphism `fun x ↦ a * x + b` is `[b, a+b]`.
535 -/
536 theorem affineHomeomorph_image_I (a b : 𝕜) (h : 0 < a) :
537     affineHomeomorph a b h.ne.symm '' Set.Icc 0 1 = Set.Icc b (a + b) := by simp [h]
538 
539 /-- The affine homeomorphism from a nontrivial interval `[a,b]` to `[0,1]`.
540 -/
541 def iccHomeoI (a b : 𝕜) (h : a < b) : Set.Icc a b ≃ₜ Set.Icc (0 : 𝕜) (1 : 𝕜) := by
542   let e := Homeomorph.image (affineHomeomorph (b - a) a (sub_pos.mpr h).ne.symm) (Set.Icc 0 1)
543   refine (e.trans ?_).symm
544   apply Homeomorph.setCongr
545   rw [affineHomeomorph_image_I _ _ (sub_pos.2 h)]
546   simp
547 
548 @[simp]
549 theorem iccHomeoI_apply_coe (a b : 𝕜) (h : a < b) (x : Set.Icc a b) :
550     ((iccHomeoI a b h) x : 𝕜) = (x - a) / (b - a) :=
551   rfl
552 
553 @[simp]
554 theorem iccHomeoI_symm_apply_coe (a b : 𝕜) (h : a < b) (x : Set.Icc (0 : 𝕜) (1 : 𝕜)) :
555     ((iccHomeoI a b h).symm x : 𝕜) = (b - a) * x + a :=
556   rfl
557 
558 end
559 
560 namespace unitInterval
561 
562 open NNReal
563 
564 /-- The coercion from `I` to `ℝ≥0`. -/
565 def toNNReal : I → ℝ≥0 := fun i ↦ ⟨i.1, i.2.1⟩
566 
567 @[simp] lemma toNNReal_zero : toNNReal 0 = 0 := rfl
568 
569 @[simp] lemma toNNReal_one : toNNReal 1 = 1 := rfl
570 
571 @[fun_prop] lemma toNNReal_continuous : Continuous toNNReal := by delta toNNReal; fun_prop
572 
573 @[simp] lemma coe_toNNReal (x : I) : ((toNNReal x) : ℝ) = x := rfl
574 
575 @[simp] lemma toNNReal_add_toNNReal_symm (x : I) : toNNReal x + toNNReal (σ x) = 1 := by ext; simp
576 @[simp] lemma toNNReal_symm_add_toNNReal (x : I) : toNNReal (σ x) + toNNReal x = 1 := by ext; simp
577 
578 end unitInterval
